name: Tiwai Island
description: A protected wildlife sanctuary on the Moa River in the Gola rainforest belt — pygmy hippos, eleven primate species including the rare Diana monkey, and forest walks led by guides from the communities who co-manage the reserve. With Gola Rainforest National Park, it is part of Sierra Leone's first UNESCO World Heritage Site (July 2025).
bestTime: November through April (dry season, easier trails)

quickFacts.flightNote: Domestic transfer to Bo or Kenema, then a road and canoe crossing to the island
quickFacts.climate: Tropical rainforest — humid year-round, heaviest rain June–September

topExperiences: A dawn primate walk with a community guide
Canoeing the Moa River at dusk for hippo sign
A guided night walk for nocturnal wildlife
Visiting the Mende villages that co-manage the reserve
